name: effnet_weight_up
base_trial: trial_062 (Perch 72% + EffNet5fold 15% + mwf0 2% + pmix 11%) — restoring trial_062 state after trial_063 degradation
strategy: trial_063 reverse analysis: mwf0 noisy hypothesis rejected (removal caused -0.001), pmix direction exhausted (0.08→0.11→0.13 all at/below 0.934). New axis: increase EffNet 5-fold weight 0.15→0.17, compress Perch 0.72→0.70. mwf0 and pmix restored to trial_062 values.
expected: 0.934 or higher. EffNet 5-fold is the most validated secondary component. Shifting 2pp from Perch to EffNet tests whether Perch is over-weighted relative to its marginal contribution.
submit_command: kaggle competitions submit -c birdclef-2026 -k ramkang/birdclef2026-effnet-5fold-blend -v 51 -f submission.csv -m 'trial_064 effnet_weight_up: Perch 70% + EffNet5fold 17% + mwf0 2% + pmix 11% kernel v51'
